title: Sloth dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a5a8a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#8a6a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='16' ry='18' fill='#a07850'/>
  <!-- light belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#d4b896'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='16' fill='#a07850'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='13' fill='#c49a6a'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#e8dcc8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#4a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#4a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='29.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy dance smile -->
  <path d='M45 36 Q50 41 55 36' stroke='#6a3a2a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='2' ry='1.4' fill='#5a3020'/>
  <!-- dark eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='30' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#7a5030' opacity='0.55'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='30' rx='3.5' ry='3' fill='#7a5030' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- left arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M32 50 Q22 40 18 28' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='26' r='4' fill='#c49a6a'/>
  <!-- right arm raised dancing -->
  <path d='M68 50 Q78 38 82 26' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='24' r='4' fill='#c49a6a'/>
  <!-- left leg kicking -->
  <path d='M42 78 Q36 88 28 90' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='91' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#c49a6a'/>
  <!-- right leg kicking -->
  <path d='M58 78 Q64 86 72 84' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#c49a6a'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffcc44'>
    <path d='M76 14 l0 -8 6 2 -6 -3 0 9z'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='16' r='2.5'/>
    <path d='M20 16 l0 -7 5 2 -5 -3 0 8z'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='18' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ff8888'>
    <path d='M82 38 l0 -6 4 1.5 -4 -2.5 0 7z'/>
    <circle cx='80.5' cy='39' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
